title: Walker: 'How do you know they didn't get up and walk away?'

tellings.quote: remember Walker saying, "We're talking about MJ12. Oh, the the dead bodies." He said, "How do you know they're dead? You assume too many things and they're all wrong. How do you know they didn't get up and walk away?"

plain: In 1987, a man named Eric A. Walker, whom the researcher Grant Cameron calls the head of the entire UFO programme, was asked about MJ-12 (a supposed secret group of top officials said to handle the UFO matter) and the dead bodies said to have been recovered from crashed craft. Walker pushed back on the idea that the bodies were dead. Cameron, who says he heard it himself, recalls Walker saying: "How do you know they're dead? You assume too many things and they're all wrong. How do you know they didn't get up and walk away?" If true, the beings from the crashes may have survived.
